mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals labor market tightness, leading to wage inflation and subsequent monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real estate sales (HOUST) above 1500 units signals strong consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST > 1500.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declines for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2.5% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is below 2% YoY, the real interest rate is high, indicating a restrictive monetary policy that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2pp in the same month, it signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where RSAFS increases for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) increases by more than 1% MoM and GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% YoY, it signals a strong supply side and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO > 1% MoM and GDPC1 > 2% YoY.
